artifacts.summary: Re-derives the live file_scope hygiene defect set (Check 8/Check 9) against the stale dispatch snapshot, and gives verified, concrete file_scope narrowing/backfill values for projects 473, 518, 567, 568, and 607; flags the dispatch's second scope item (scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh) as citing a nonexistent file.

memory_candidates.content: Task 531 research: validate-state.sh's Check 8 (coarse whole-directory file_scope) and Check 9 (duplicates) counts drift fast in this repo -- a dispatch-embedded snapshot (e.g. '28 of 52 missing file_scope') went stale within the same task's lifetime (live count: 3 of 137). Always re-run validate-state.sh live rather than trusting a count carried in task/dispatch prose, even prose written for this exact remediation.

scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh (cited by context/patterns/task-abandon-mode.md and skills/skill-todo/SKILL.md as the WIRED_REPO un-tracking detector for archived task directories) does not exist anywhere in this repository's working tree or git history. Only prose citations exist; no mechanical detector is wired. Likely a citation carried over from a cross-repo task migration without re-pointing.

When narrowing a coarse whole-directory file_scope entry to file-level entries, narrowing does not and should not eliminate real per-file territory overlap with other open tasks -- it only removes the Check 8 WARN that exists specifically to flag overlap caused by declared-but-unused breadth. Verify this distinction (narrowed-but-still-overlapping is a pass, not a new defect) before assuming narrowing must shrink the overlapping-task set.
